feeds.title: COMUNITYmade Blog
feeds.description: Find out about what shoes can do for you & your community at the COMUNITYmade blog! Read about Custom shoes, handmade leather shoes, and more. COMUNITYmade is a catalyst for change; inspiring action, participation and empowerment of others in the community. We make premium shoes, handcrafted locally that give back locally, to fuel our mission.

feeds.title: The Shoe Snob Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to The Shoe Snob Blog! This blog was created to not only show the journey of one man, Justin FitzPatrick, who wanted to make the shoe industry the best it could be but also the share all of the knowledge gained along the way. Ultimately this blog is about seeing men wearing better shoes through education and sharing what is out there that deserves recognition.

feeds.title: Bespoke Shoes Unlaced
feeds.description: This blog is for people who want to make shoes by hand; or those who aspire to it; or those who simply share our interest in shoemaking. Carreducker's mission is to make the most beautiful, must-have men's shoes, traditionally crafted in England with a contemporary aesthetic.

feeds.title: Simple Shoemaking Blog
feeds.description: All of Simple Shoemaking footwear is made ecologically, which means that all its processes avoid toxic shoe cements and new petroleum-based soling. Sharon's goal is to help people make shoes for themselves, their families and frends, and start shoemaking businesses if this is their goal.

feeds.title: Shoemaking Courses Online | Blog
feeds.description: Learn how to make shoes with our shoe making video courses. Make ballet flat shoes, ankle boots, sandals, oxford shoes, learn to make your own shoes.

feeds.title: MI Shoe Making Craft
feeds.description: In 2006 I decided to shift my primary craft focus to the Art of Making Shoes. Shoes are hard to make. This is where I am so far. I like to call myself a 'Self Directed Apprentice'I also make custom tools for Shoe and Boot Making

feeds.title: Adelante Shoe Co. Blog
feeds.description: Learn about the Adelante Journey, our trials and tribulations, our successes and advancements and how we plan to change the world in our blog. We sell connective products and experiences to fund sustainable economic development in Latin America. Individualize your style, meet your craftsman, live your values.

feeds.title: Fuchsia Blog
feeds.description: Stories of Fuchsia artisans, shoes and a lot more. We make beautifully handcrafted artisan shoes that are comfortable and sustainable while changing the lives of marginalized communities.

feeds.title: Fumu Blog
feeds.description: A shoemaker's blog by Fumu. Check out the latest posts on the life of bespoke shoemakers in Singapore. In 2016, Tor moved to Japan to pursue the craft of handmade bespoke shoes. He established Fumu to develop and promote the handcraft sector of Singapore through shoe making.

feeds.title: Blog - Shoemakers Academy
feeds.description: The Sneaker Factory website was created in 2004 by practicing design professionals. I'm in the shoe trade. I have worked as a Designer, Developer, Product Line Manager, Development Group Manager, Advanced Projects Group Manager, Buyer, and Sourcing Manager. I have experience working on sports shoes for running, skating, biking, brown shoes, hunting, hiking, and snowboarding boots.

feeds.title: I Can Make Shoes Blog
feeds.description: I CAN MAKE SHOES is a shoe-making school born teaching innovative shoe-making techniques in London and New York. We also have an online store for supplies.
